description: This file defines a CMake function named 'dfs_callback' that performs a depth-first search traversal of a data structure (potentially nested maps and lists), emitting events for different structural components (lists, maps, values, references). It is used to traverse complex data structures within CMake scripts and calls a user-provided callback for each event.

methods.name: dfs_callback
methods.description: Main function that initiates a depth-first traversal, setting up the internal callback emitter and calling the recursive inner function to traverse and emit events for the data structure.

methods.name: dfs_callback_inner
methods.description: Recursive inner function that performs the depth-first traversal, emitting specific events for list, map, and value nodes, and handling already visited nodes to support references.
